Players Committee card image of [[Double Back (V)]] (original printing), game text: “USED: Take 4-LOM, non-[Maintenance] Boba Fett, Danz Borin, or Dengar into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: During your move phase, your bounty hunter (or [Independent] starship they are piloting) may make an additional move. OR Move your bounty hunter as a 'react'.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/doubleback.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
